svg.desc: Five candidate sources - two-tower ANN, co-visitation, followed sellers, fresh items and trending - merge into about 2,000 candidates, then a pre-ranker to 500, a multi-task heavy ranker and a re-ranking step to a page of 20, with per-stage latency.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Design A: a home feed for 50M daily users

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Five candidate sources feed one cascade. Numbers are design assumptions, stated aloud.
